title: Make your bǐ comparisons boring and short
summary: Keep the winner first, the adjective plain, and the size of the gap in one small extra word.
attribution: Original content authored for this project.

blocks.body: The frame is A 比 bǐ B plus adjective, and everything you add must fit that skeleton. Do not put 很 hěn or 非常 fēicháng in front of the adjective, and do not write 不比 bù bǐ when you mean about equal; for no gap, 差不多 chàbuduō does the job. To size a gap, bolt a small word onto the adjective: 贵一点儿 guì yìdiǎnr (a little dearer), 高多了 gāo duō le (much taller), 快得多 kuài de duō (far faster). Practise a fixed opening line for everyday use, such as 这个比那个贵一点儿 zhège bǐ nàge guì yìdiǎnr, and reuse it with new adjectives until it costs you nothing.

blocks.title: Four frames to reuse
body: 今天比昨天热。 jīntiān bǐ zuótiān rè. — Today is hotter than yesterday.
贵一点儿。 guì yìdiǎnr. — A bit more expensive.
他没有我高。 tā méiyǒu wǒ gāo. — He is not as tall as I am.
我们俩差不多。 wǒmen liǎ chàbuduō. — The two of us are about the same.
